notifications.title: Research for a 3rd or 4th channel is blocked every night by the 2-merges-a-day cap
notifications.detail: scripts/guard.py MAX_MERGES_PER_DAY = 2 counts every research merge in an IST day across all channels (merges_today). Research now runs for 4 channels, so the first two to finish merge and the rest are blocked: Paisa Panchayat's research (agent/research/2026-11-20) was blocked at 22:25 IST on 19 Nov, and this Craze & Crash run (agent/research/2026-11-20/business-documentaries-rise-and-fall-of: 4 topics, 1 proposal) is blocked for the same reason. Agents may not change the guard.
notifications.fix: 1. In scripts/guard.py, count merges per agent per channel for PER_CHANNEL_AGENTS (match the branch's /<slug> suffix in merges_today), or raise the cap for research. 2. Re-run the Agent merge workflow on agent/research/2026-11-20/business-documentaries-rise-and-fall-of and agent/research/2026-11-20 (or the next nightly run re-submits them).
